description: Permanently removes one rule from a security group; machines with the group lose it at once. Ask the user first. When a machine gets a public URL, the platform opens that port to any address in every security group the machine has at that moment, and closes it when the URL is removed. A group attached later does not have it. Removing such a rule takes that URL offline, and removing the rule for port 22 ends SSH from outside. Get the rule id from list_security_groups (each group lists its rules).

id.description: The rule to remove: an id from a group's rules in list_security_groups.

name: delete_security_group_rule
title: Delete security group rule
